data_classification.description: Marks this record as generated portfolio data.

feature_event_id.description: Unique identity for this feature snapshot.

entity_token.description: Synthetic token for the entity; not a direct identifier.

feature_version.description: Version of the feature calculation logic.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the event-time aggregation window.

window_end.description: Exclusive end of the event-time aggregation window.

window_seconds.description: Length of the aggregation window in seconds.

transaction_count.description: Number of payments observed for this entity/window.

amount_sum.description: Sum of amounts in the currency field for this window.

currency.description: Currency for amount_sum; do not add unlike currencies.

distinct_merchant_count.description: Number of distinct synthetic merchants in the window.

new_device_count.description: Number of first-seen devices in the window.

computed_at.description: When this feature snapshot was computed, UTC.
